newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in dull trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were little changed on Monday, traders said.
One trader in Medan said people were cautious in Medan due to the on-going campaign for May 29 general elections which caused people to sideline and take a wait-and-see attitude.
Another said palm olein was quoted at 1,445-50 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from Friday. He said interest was thin.
Crude palm oil was offered at 1,262 rupiah/kg, compared with Friday price at 1,252 rupiah/kg in Medan.
Another trader said the higher price was due to an auction in Medan last Friday which was cancelled. However, traders were looking at the cancelled price as a sort of benchmark.
"I don't think anybody would take it. It's too high," the trader said, adding that 1,250 rupiah should be a good level.
